- "Start the web service in my sprite and give me its URL.""},{"id":"p25s1","text":"An empty sprite list is a successful authenticated response."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Authentication and access"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The hosted endpoint is `https://sprites.dev/mcp` and uses OAuth 2.1. `mcp-remote` stores its OAuth s"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"tate in its normal local credential directory; this repository contains no credentials."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The Sprites consent screen normally creates a restricted connector token.
